# testdata/

Small, committed test-file set used by the tests and the seeder.

**Licence statement:** all files are generated by `scripts/make_testdata.py` from project-authored text; no
third-party content, no personal data.

## Layout

| Path | Content | Expected class | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/sample.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.xls`, `.xlsx`, `.ppt`, `.pptx`, `.txt` | one page/sheet/slide: "Smart Index test file (<type>)" | DOCUMENT | Open with per type |
| `other/sample.zip`, `sample.apk` (zip with an empty `AndroidManifest.xml`, not installable), `sample.json`, `sample.xyz`, `noextension` | small | OTHER_FILE | |
| `other/sample.csv` | 3 rows | **DOCUMENT** (csv is in `DOCUMENT_EXTS`; an earlier plan listed it under other files; the media classifier is authoritative) | |
| `bad/corrupt.pdf` | `%PDF-1.4` + 2 KB fixed pattern, no xref/EOF | DOCUMENT | |
| `bad/password-protected.pdf` | AES-128, password `sidx` | DOCUMENT | |
| `bad/password-protected.docx` | agile encryption, password `sidx` | DOCUMENT | |
| `bad/zero-byte.pdf` | 0 bytes | DOCUMENT | |
| `bad/photo-renamed.pdf` | PNG bytes with a `.pdf` name | DOCUMENT (by extension/MIME) | wrong extension |
| `bad/document-renamed.jpg` | PDF bytes with a `.jpg` name | PHOTO (thumbnail fails, type tile) | |
| `us002/Hotel booking.pdf` | body "Itinerary" only | DOCUMENT; found by `booking` | |
| `us002/scan_0042.pdf` | body "Your booking reference is SIDX-4711" | DOCUMENT; **not** found by `booking reference` | negative case: body text is not searched |
| `i18n/` Devanagari-named `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.docx` | Devanagari file names | DOCUMENT | |
| `recordings/sample-names.tsv` | recording-name corpus for the matcher parser, read by `RecordingPlanTest` | n/a | |

Each committed file is under 100 KB. `MANIFEST.tsv` (UTF-8, tab-separated, header
`path	bytes	sha256	expected_type	purpose`) lists every committed file except the recording-name TSV;
`TestdataManifestTest` (`:tools:seeder`) keeps it honest.

## Regenerate

```
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r testdata/scripts/requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python testdata/scripts/make_testdata.py          # rewrites the files and MANIFEST.tsv
.venv/bin/python testdata/scripts/make_testdata.py --check  # regenerates into a temp dir, compares SHA-256 with MANIFEST.tsv
```

The generator is deterministic (fixed timestamps; random sources are seeded while generating). Legacy
`docs/sample.doc` and `docs/sample.ppt` are converted from the generated docx/pptx with
`soffice --headless --convert-to`; LibreOffice output is not byte-stable, so these two files are **excluded
from `--check`**. If `soffice` is not on PATH the script writes a minimal OLE2 stub with the right magic bytes
instead (classification by extension/MIME works, but real viewers cannot open it): regenerate on a machine with
LibreOffice before relying on Open with for DOC/PPT.

## Push to a device

```
testdata/scripts/push_testdata.sh   # adb push docs other bad us002 i18n /sdcard/Download/sidx-testdata/
adb shell content query --uri content://media/external/file --projection _display_name:mime_type \
  --where "relative_path LIKE 'Download/sidx-testdata/%'"
adb shell rm -r /sdcard/Download/sidx-testdata               # cleanup
```

### Huge file (not committed)

`testdata/scripts/push_huge.sh` creates a 60 MB sparse `sidx-huge-60mb.pdf` in `/sdcard/Download/` (a file over 50 MB) and prints the cleanup command.

## Notes

- `recordings/sample-names.tsv` grows when real recording names are captured from a device (personal data
  removed). It is not in `MANIFEST.tsv`.
- No personal data, ever: no real names, numbers, messages or photos of real people.
